research_question: How do ACH and wire transfers differ in speed, cost, finality, and best uses?

research_brief.purpose: Compare the ACH and Fedwire payment rails for consumers and businesses.
research_brief.audience: U.S. consumers and small businesses choosing how to send money.
research_brief.data_period: Nacha Q3 2026; Fedwire September 2026; rules checked October 26, 2026.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Network-level facts; bank fees, cutoffs, and limits vary by institution.

statistics.claim: ACH Network carried 9.3 billion payments worth $25.6 trillion in Q3 2026, up 5.9% and 10.2%.
Same Day ACH carried 470.4 million payments worth $1.3 trillion in Q3 2026, up 36.7%.
Fedwire handled 19,786,425 transfers worth about $105.15 trillion in September 2026, averaging $5.31 million.

Few separate settlement risk from fraud risk when calling wires safer.
